name: Retail Stock Balance
query:
SELECT
    q.retail_stock_item AS "Retail Stock Item:Link/Retail Stock Item:220",
    q.stock_item_name AS "Stock Item Name:Data:220",
    q.metal AS "Metal:Data:90",

    q.total_in AS "Total In:Float:120",
    q.total_out AS "Total Out:Float:120",
    q.current_stock AS "Current Stock:Float:140",

    q.article_category AS "Article Category:Link/Jewellery Item Type:160",
    q.purity AS "Purity:Link/Metal Purity:130",
    q.gold_size AS "Gold Size:Data:100",
    q.silver_size AS "Silver Size:Data:100",
    q.brand AS "Brand:Data:100",
    q.variant_design AS "Variant / Design:Data:160"

FROM (

    /* ========================================================
       SECTION HEADER
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        0 AS section_order,
        0 AS metal_order,
        'SUMMARY_HEADER' AS row_type,

        NULL AS retail_stock_item,
        'CURRENT RETAIL STOCK SUMMARY' AS stock_item_name,
        NULL AS metal,

        NULL AS total_in,
        NULL AS total_out,
        NULL AS current_stock,

        NULL AS article_category,
        NULL AS purity,
        NULL AS gold_size,
        NULL AS silver_size,
        NULL AS brand,
        NULL AS variant_design


    UNION ALL


    /* ========================================================
       GOLD SUMMARY
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        1 AS section_order,
        1 AS metal_order,
        'SUMMARY' AS row_type,

        NULL AS retail_stock_item,
        NULL AS stock_item_name,
        'GOLD' AS metal,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_in,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_out,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            )
            -
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS current_stock,

        NULL AS article_category,
        NULL AS purity,
        NULL AS gold_size,
        NULL AS silver_size,
        NULL AS brand,
        NULL AS variant_design

    FROM `tabJewellery Stock Transaction` rst

    LEFT JOIN `tabRetail Stock Item` rsi
        ON rsi.name = rst.retail_stock_item

    WHERE
        rst.retail_stock_item IS NOT NULL
        AND rsi.metal = 'Gold'


    UNION ALL


    /* ========================================================
       SILVER SUMMARY
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        1 AS section_order,
        2 AS metal_order,
        'SUMMARY' AS row_type,

        NULL AS retail_stock_item,
        NULL AS stock_item_name,
        'SILVER' AS metal,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_in,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_out,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            )
            -
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS current_stock,

        NULL AS article_category,
        NULL AS purity,
        NULL AS gold_size,
        NULL AS silver_size,
        NULL AS brand,
        NULL AS variant_design

    FROM `tabJewellery Stock Transaction` rst

    LEFT JOIN `tabRetail Stock Item` rsi
        ON rsi.name = rst.retail_stock_item

    WHERE
        rst.retail_stock_item IS NOT NULL
        AND rsi.metal = 'Silver'


    UNION ALL


    /* ========================================================
       DETAILS HEADER
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        2 AS section_order,
        0 AS metal_order,
        'DETAIL_HEADER' AS row_type,

        NULL AS retail_stock_item,
        'RETAIL STOCK DETAILS' AS stock_item_name,
        NULL AS metal,

        NULL AS total_in,
        NULL AS total_out,
        NULL AS current_stock,

        NULL AS article_category,
        NULL AS purity,
        NULL AS gold_size,
        NULL AS silver_size,
        NULL AS brand,
        NULL AS variant_design


    UNION ALL


    /* ========================================================
       INDIVIDUAL RETAIL STOCK ITEMS
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        3 AS section_order,

        CASE
            WHEN rsi.metal = 'Gold' THEN 1
            WHEN rsi.metal = 'Silver' THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END AS metal_order,

        'DETAIL' AS row_type,

        rst.retail_stock_item,
        rsi.stock_item_name,
        rsi.metal,

        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_in,

        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_out,

        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
            -
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            3
        ) AS current_stock,

        rst.item AS article_category,
        rst.purity,
        rsi.gold_size,
        rsi.silver_size,
        rsi.brand,
        rsi.variant_design

    FROM `tabJewellery Stock Transaction` rst

    LEFT JOIN `tabRetail Stock Item` rsi
        ON rsi.name = rst.retail_stock_item

    WHERE
        rst.retail_stock_item IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        rst.retail_stock_item,
        rsi.stock_item_name,
        rsi.metal,
        rst.item,
        rst.purity,
        rsi.gold_size,
        rsi.silver_size,
        rsi.brand,
        rsi.variant_design

    HAVING
        %(view)s = 'Full View'
        OR
        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
            -
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            3
        ) > 0
) q

ORDER BY
    q.section_order,
    q.metal_order,
    q.stock_item_name,
    q.retail_stock_item;

name: GST Summary
query:
SELECT
    si.name AS "Invoice:Data:140",
    si.sales_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    'Sale' AS "Type:Data:80",
    si.customer_name AS "Party:Data:160",
    si.customer_gstin AS "GSTIN:Data:130",
    si.subtotal AS "Taxable:Currency:120",
    si.gst_rate AS "GST Rate:Percent:90",
    si.gst_amount AS "GST:Currency:120",
    si.grand_total AS "Total:Currency:130"
FROM `tabJewellery Sales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.sales_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
UNION ALL
SELECT
    pi.name AS "Invoice:Data:140",
    pi.purchase_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    'Purchase' AS "Type:Data:80",
    pi.supplier_name AS "Party:Data:160",
    pi.supplier_gstin AS "GSTIN:Data:130",
    pi.subtotal AS "Taxable:Currency:120",
    pi.gst_rate AS "GST Rate:Percent:90",
    pi.gst AS "GST:Currency:120",
    pi.grand_total AS "Total:Currency:130"
FROM `tabJewellery Purchase Invoice` pi
WHERE pi.docstatus = 1
  AND pi.purchase_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY 2 ASC

name: HUID Register
query:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        rsi.name AS "Stock ID:Link/Retail Stock Item:110",
        rsi.stock_item_name AS "Item Name:Data:180",
        rsi.metal AS "Metal:Data:70",
        rsi.purity AS "Purity:Link/Metal Purity:110",
        rsi.hallmark_status AS "Hallmark:Data:120",
        rsi.huid AS "HUID:Data:130",
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rst.movement = 'In' THEN rst.weight ELSE 0 END), 0), 3) AS total_in,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rst.movement = 'Out' THEN rst.weight ELSE 0 END), 0), 3) AS total_out,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rst.movement = 'In' THEN rst.weight ELSE -rst.weight END), 0), 3) AS current_stock
    FROM `tabRetail Stock Item` rsi
    LEFT JOIN `tabJewellery Stock Transaction` rst
      ON rst.retail_stock_item = rsi.name AND rst.docstatus = 1
    WHERE (%(metal)s = '' OR rsi.metal = %(metal)s)
      AND (%(hallmark_status)s = '' OR rsi.hallmark_status = %(hallmark_status)s)
    GROUP BY rsi.name
) t
WHERE (%(view)s = 'Full View' OR t.current_stock > 0)
ORDER BY 3, 2

name: Worker Balances
query:
SELECT
    w.name AS "Worker:Link/Worker:140",
    w.mobile_number AS "Mobile:Data:120",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabJewellery Order` o WHERE o.worker = w.name AND o.docstatus < 2) AS "Orders:Int:80",
    ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pure_gold_delta) FROM `tabWorker Settlement` s WHERE s.worker = w.name AND s.docstatus = 1), 0), 3) AS "Gold Bal (g):Float:110",
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cash_delta) FROM `tabWorker Settlement` s WHERE s.worker = w.name AND s.docstatus = 1), 0) AS "Cash Bal:Currency:130"
FROM `tabWorker` w
ORDER BY 1

name: Customer Outstanding
query:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    si.customer_name AS "Customer:Data:200",
    COUNT(*) AS "Bills:Int:70",
    SUM(si.grand_total) AS "Billed:Currency:130",
    SUM(si.total_paid) AS "Paid:Currency:130",
    SUM(si.grand_total - si.total_paid) AS "Outstanding:Currency:130"
FROM `tabJewellery Sales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY si.customer_name
) t
WHERE (%(show_settled)s = 'All' OR t.`Outstanding:Currency:130` > 0)
ORDER BY 5 DESC
